faq.a7: warpKRON will launch on Base (EVM), chain ID 8453, following the KRON Fair Launch Standard. Always confirm you are on Base before interacting after deployment.
faq.q8: What is the official warpKRON contract address?
faq.a8: No contract is deployed yet. The official address will be published on the verification page only after fair launch. Do not trust any other address.
faq.q9: How do I contact the warpKRON team?
faq.a9: Official project email: team@warpkron.com. Only trust communications from official domains (warpkron.com) and verified channels.
faq.q10: Is warpKRON financial advice or an investment?
faq.a10: No. warpKRON is an experimental memecoin for culture and community. This website is informational only — not financial, legal, or tax advice. You may lose all funds. DYOR.
faq.a1: No. warpKRON and all KRON Family memecoins follow the KRON Fair Launch Standard — no presale and no private sale, ever. Infrastructure tokens (ENK, SOVRA, ENM) may use structured raises; memecoins do not.
faq.a2: Seven independent experimental memecoins sharing a brand universe: eKRON, soviKRON, mineKRON, alviKRON, puriKRON, puppyKRON, and warpKRON. Each has its own contract and risk profile. Primary gateway: www.ekron.network. See the full roster.
faq.q3: Is warpKRON the same as EnteleKron?
faq.a3: No. warpKRON is a memecoin. EnteleKron is sovereign infrastructure. Names are connected by brand family — they are not the same asset or protocol.
faq.a4: Every KRON memecoin: 10B fixed supply, 80% fair-launch LP, 10% ecosystem (12-month lock), 5% founder (6-month lock), 5% founder (12-month lock). Enforced by on-chain timelocks via the launch program.
faq.q5: How do I verify the official contract?
faq.a5: Only trust addresses on the official verification page and announcements from official domains. If it is not verified there, assume it is not official. warpKRON has no contract yet.
faq.a6: warpKRON is Phase III demand-gated. Deployment follows organic community demand — no timeline guarantees. Culture and community experiments come first.
